whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: New migration 20261020_0017 conditionally (0002 section 10 / 0005 pattern) adding event_registrations.group_code text NULL with CHECK event_registrations_group_code_len (char_length <= 64; NULL passes a CHECK by definition) plus composite index event_registrations_event_group_code_idx on (event, group_code) -- all access is event-scoped. No backfill, no NOT NULL, no default, no GRANT/REVOKE (group_code is a staff-chosen operational label, not PII; Directus role matrix untouched), no trigger/function/rule/FK -- nothing for the rollback-control gate to reconcile. Skips loudly with a NOTICE naming the Directus field spec where the owning slice's table is absent. Down script refuses (restrict_violation) while any non-null group_code exists, else drops the index, the CHECK, then the column; all statements IF EXISTS so an absent host table is a NOTICE-loud no-op. Suite 84 stands up a minimal (id, event) stub only where the owning slice has not landed, re-applies the real forward file, pins column presence/nullability/type/CHECK/index, pins 65-char rejection (23514) with 64-char and NULL acceptance, runs the empty-table rollback and pins the column+index gone, re-applies forward for idempotence, then drops the stub where it created one so the owning slice's CREATE never meets a fork. Route: validated group_code stamped onto every created row payload; read path (idempotency pre-check fields) deliberately unchanged so it keeps working pre-sync. data-model.md section 3.2 gains the group_code row and (event, group_code) in the index list. Contract test: the 'does not persist' assertion is replaced with a persistence assertion.
deviationsStated: Two, both declared.
